name: swim-coach
description: Review pool swims and propose reproducible, explainable weekly training plans safely.

interface.shortDescription: Review and safely update swim training
interface.longDescription: Review authenticated swims, goals, workouts, proposals, and sync status; generate reproducible weekly plan proposals with versioned rules and ordered decisions; and retain complete headless workflows plus exact-hash confirmation boundaries.
defaultPrompt: Use Swim Coach to review my latest swim.
Use Swim Coach to show my swimming goal progress.
Use Swim Coach to explain why my latest swim is missing.
Use Swim Coach to adapt my next swim.
Use Swim Coach to publish my workout to Garmin safely.
Use Swim Coach to record my post-swim feedback.
Use Swim Coach to propose my next swim-training week for review.
